REDRAGON.NAME: Redragon Bot
REDRAGON.DESCRIPTION: My first bot, my first code, my biggest idea...

AMENS.NAME: AMENS
AMENS.DESCRIPTION: Work in progress, in validation stage, basically a SaaS for workplace health and safety.

CRUDAPI.NAME: My first API
CRUDAPI.DESCRIPTION: A project I built to test my skills — technically a CRUD app, focused on learning SQL, Express, and other technologies.

DASHBOARD.NAME: Bot Dashboard
DASHBOARD.DESCRIPTION: My first idea for a full website, built around needs I had at the time — meant to be an all-in-one dashboard.

FEIRA.NAME: Science Fair Project
FEIRA.DESCRIPTION: For a school science fair, I built a face-recognition tool that estimated a person's age through a webcam.

FIRSTPORTFOLIO.NAME: First Portfolio
FIRSTPORTFOLIO.DESCRIPTION: My first attempt at showcasing my skills — a simple site presenting myself and a few of my main projects.

HECTARA.NAME: Hectara
HECTARA.DESCRIPTION: Built with 2 school friends — an AI-powered SaaS for small-scale farmers.

LASTPORTFOLIO.NAME: Current Portfolio
LASTPORTFOLIO.DESCRIPTION: Needs no introduction — my most ambitious web project so far.

MPBOT.NAME: Bot with Mercado Pago integration
MPBOT.DESCRIPTION: Right after PIX launched (Brazil's instant bank-transfer payment system), a client asked me to build a sales bot with PIX support — I delivered a full Discord sales system.

MUSICBOT.NAME: Music Bot
MUSICBOT.DESCRIPTION: One of my favorite hobby projects — there was some friendly rivalry over who could build the lightest music bot. I got mine running on just 60MB of RAM.

RPGBOT.NAME: Tank RPG Bot
RPGBOT.DESCRIPTION: Built with a lot of effort — one of my biggest projects, meant to showcase a library I was developing at the time.

SECONDS.NAME: 60 Seconds on Roblox
SECONDS.DESCRIPTION: A Roblox game I'm quite proud of. Though unfinished, it taught me many new skills — it's exactly what the name suggests, reimagined in a different universe.

VSCODE.NAME: Discloud VS Code extension
VSCODE.DESCRIPTION: The platform owner invited me to build this extension. Reading the VS Code docs was a struggle, but it taught me a lot and led to a good friendship.

WARCORD.NAME: Warcord
WARCORD.DESCRIPTION: By far my biggest and best-organized project — a library that consumed the API of every WarGaming game.
